Omnisend has a $0 plan and cheaper SMS, so it suits newer stores. Klaviyo's free plan is small (250 profiles), but its segmentation and Shopify data depth make it the usual pick as you grow.
Judge.me has a free plan and a flat $15/mo paid plan. Loox focuses on photo/video reviews and referrals and is paid only (free trial).
Both have free entry plans. Judge.me stays cheap (flat $15/mo), while Yotpo's bundles (from $89/mo) add loyalty and suit larger brands.
Recharge starts at $99/mo + 1.49% + 19¢ per transaction. Skio starts at $499/mo (annual) + 1% + 20¢ and targets brands with established subscription revenue.
Both start around $99/mo. Loop charges $0 per-order fees, while Recharge adds a per-transaction processing fee.
Shippo has a free Starter plan (up to 30 labels/mo) and Pro from $17/mo. ShipStation starts at $14.99/mo for 50 shipments with a 30-day trial and scales by volume.
Gorgias is built for e-commerce and priced by ticket volume (from $40/mo). Zendesk is a general helpdesk priced per agent (from $19/agent/mo annual).
Both are drag-and-drop Shopify page builders. We haven't verified current pricing for either yet, so check each vendor's site.
Smile.io paid plans start at $15/mo, so it's easier for small stores. LoyaltyLion's Classic plan is $199/mo and aimed at brands taking loyalty seriously.
Microsoft Clarity is free forever with no traffic limits. Hotjar (now part of Contentsquare) adds surveys and other features. Check the vendor for current Hotjar pricing.
Triple Whale has a free plan and is popular with Shopify brands. Northbeam is a paid multi-touch attribution tool aimed at brands with bigger ad budgets.

Both have free plans. Klaviyo syncs deeply with Shopify data for flows and segmentation and suits growing stores; Mailchimp is a well-known general email tool with a Shopify integration that suits new stores.

Shopify Email is free up to 10,000 emails/mo and runs inside your admin, a simple start for new stores. Klaviyo adds deep segmentation and flows for growing stores, with a free plan up to 250 profiles.
PageFly is a drag-and-drop page builder for new stores. Shogun adds optimisation and personalisation, with a free Draft Mode (no publishing) and Build from $39/mo.
GemPages is a page builder with templates and CRO elements, suited to new stores. Replo is a landing page builder aimed at growth teams. Check each vendor for current pricing.
Tidio is live chat and an AI chatbot for small stores, paid from $24.17/mo. Gorgias is a full e-commerce helpdesk with order data in tickets, from $40/mo, for growing stores.
Triple Whale focuses on attribution and has a free plan. Polar Analytics is centralised analytics and BI aimed at larger stores. Check the vendor for Polar pricing.
AfterSell does post-purchase and checkout upsells from $59.99/mo. Rebuy covers AI upsells, cross-sells and a smart cart, with build-your-own plans from $25/mo.
Both focus on post-purchase upsells. AfterSell starts at $59.99/mo with a 30-day trial and is capped at $599.99/mo; ReConvert (now Upsell.com) is priced in tiers by order volume.
Loop pushes exchanges over refunds on fixed plans from $155/mo. Redo is a returns and post-purchase platform with usage-based pricing per order.
AfterShip is mainly branded tracking and notifications, from $29/mo, and also handles returns. Loop is a dedicated returns and exchanges platform from $155/mo for larger stores.
Okendo bundles reviews, UGC, loyalty and quizzes. Yotpo offers reviews (free up to 50 orders/mo, paid from $15/mo) plus loyalty and referrals, aimed at mid-size and large brands.
Klaviyo covers email and SMS and has a free plan, which suits growing stores. Attentive is an enterprise SMS and email platform with custom pricing for larger brands.
Both offer heatmaps and session recordings. Lucky Orange adds live chat and starts at $32/mo (annual); Hotjar adds surveys and is now part of Contentsquare.
Smile.io focuses on loyalty points, VIP tiers and referrals from $15/mo. Yotpo is a broader reviews, loyalty and referrals suite for mid-size and large brands.
These solve different problems: ShipStation is software for printing your own labels (from $14.99/mo), while ShipBob is an outsourced 3PL that stores and ships your products for you.
Pirate Ship is free with no monthly fees, but covers USPS and UPS only. ShipStation is multi-carrier with order management, from $14.99/mo after a 30-day trial.
